name: [💎] Fly with Brainrot
desc:
🕊️ Fly With Brainrot! ☄️

🧠 Ride Brainrots and soar through the sky!
☄️ Dodge incoming meteors!
💸 Collect the rarest Brainrots and earn cash!
🚀 Rarer Brainrots fly farther and stay in the air longer!
⚡ Upgrade to fly faster and higher than ever before!
💤 Your Brainrots earn money even while you're offline!

👍 Don't forget to leave a Like and join the community 😎
